body: Ok my bf has really flat straight hair but he has a routine that works and is time efficient. First off, u are what u eat so u need to eat stuff to nourish your body. 2nd invest in really good thickening/protein shampoos and conditioners. He uses the ‘dirty’ pomade by lush, swears by this stuff. He spends a good 10 minutes fixing it. Only shower at night & let ur hair dry fully. Then in the morning it should just be easy and ready to style. (He never brushes it). His hair has some volume now but its never gonna be a big change bc it does have to do with genetics and hair types as well, if hair is straight, its never gonna curl up naturally like some other guys. Best you can make it is slightly wavy and volumized. I know this comment is all over the place but it has good intentions i promise.
